# Voi Home

> Voi Home is a boutique real estate advisory in Istanbul, Türkiye. It helps international buyers, investors and families buy, rent, manage and furnish homes in Istanbul, with personal advice in English and Arabic, and guidance on residence permits and Turkish citizenship by investment.

## Company facts

- Name: Voi Home
- Website: https://voi-home.com
- Office: Zeytinburnu, Istanbul, Türkiye
- Phone and WhatsApp: +90 552 797 10 00
- Email: info@voi-home.com
- Languages: English, Arabic
- Market: Istanbul (European and Asian sides), plus selected homes in Bodrum
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/voi.home/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/voi-home

## Services

- [Property sales](https://voi-home.com/services/property-sales): finding and buying the right home, from shortlist to title deed.
- [Property rentals](https://voi-home.com/services/property-rentals): long-term rentals for tenants and landlords.
- [Investment advisory](https://voi-home.com/services/investment-advisory): area and property analysis, rental yield and resale potential.
- [Property management](https://voi-home.com/services/property-management): tenants, rent collection and maintenance for owners abroad.
- [After-sales support](https://voi-home.com/services/after-sales-support): utilities, residence permit paperwork and settling in after purchase.
- [Citizenship assistance](https://voi-home.com/services/citizenship-assistance): coordinating Turkish citizenship by real estate investment (minimum USD 400,000, held for three years).
- [Interior design](https://voi-home.com/services/interior-design): design and furnishing in eight styles.
- [Project sales and sales office setup](https://voi-home.com/services/project-sales-office-setup): sales strategy and sales offices for developers.
